title: Eglītis and Ratnieks (Case C-294/10), 12 May 2011
excerpt: an air carrier, since it is obliged to implement all reasonable measures to avoid extraordinary circumstances, must reasonably, at the stage of organising the flight, take account of the risk of delay connected to the possible occurrence of such circumstances. It must, consequently, provide for a certain reserve time to allow it, if possible, to operate the flight in its entirety once the extraordinary circumstances have come to an end.
summary: Reasonable measures include planning a certain reserve time so the flight can still be operated once the extraordinary circumstances end.
